text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Suddenly I'm sensing a great deal of pressure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか
すごい圧を感じるわね……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Does that mean he's been downplaying his power this whole time?!
text_block_list.orig_text: さっきまでのは本気じゃなかったってことですか！？

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Come on, seriously?
But giving up just 'cause the enemy's tough isn't the Elizabeth Park way,
is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～
やんなっちゃうね～
けど、
相手が強いからってあきらめる
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】
じゃないんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Uh, that's pretty much what I wanted to say to you...
But she's right!
We're gonna throw you to the cows and take back our ranch!
text_block_list.orig_text:
リンリンに言いてえことを
先に言われちまったべ……
でもその通りだ！
あんたを倒して
オラたちの牧場を取り戻すだよ！
